text: Understanding databases is essential for managing information effectively. There are two main types: SQL databases, which store data in tables with rows and columns, and NoSQL databases, which are more flexible and handle unstructured data. To work with data, we use queries—special commands that let us search, add, or change information. Good data modeling helps organize information clearly so it is easy to use and maintain. Indexes also improve performance by making searches faster. Choosing the right database and designing it well can save time and help applications run smoothly.
